fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Power-Off
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: VDD removed; all volatile state lost. Persistent state and primary seeds preserved in NV.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Init
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: Power applied; self-test in progress. TPM responds TPM_RC_INITIALIZE to every command except TPM2_Startup.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Started-CLEAR
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: TPM2_Startup(TPM_SU_CLEAR) executed; PCRs reset, transient slots empty, sessions empty. Normal operating state on cold boot.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Started-STATE
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: TPM2_Startup(TPM_SU_STATE) executed; restored state from a prior TPM2_Shutdown(TPM_SU_STATE) (resume from sleep).

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Operation
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: TPM accepts and executes commands per Part 3. Most commands run here.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Failure
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: TPM detected an internal inconsistency. Only TPM2_GetTestResult / TPM2_GetCapability are accepted; all other commands return TPM_RC_FAILURE.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Field-Upgrade
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: TPM2_FieldUpgradeStart engaged; vendor-controlled firmware update in progress.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Shutdown-CLEAR
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: Following TPM2_Shutdown(TPM_SU_CLEAR); orderly halt. Next power cycle starts in Init then Started-CLEAR.

fsm_states_tpm_operational.name: Shutdown-STATE
fsm_states_tpm_operational.description: Following TPM2_Shutdown(TPM_SU_STATE); state saved for resume. Next TPM2_Startup(TPM_SU_STATE) restores.

fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.name: Idle
fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.description: TPM_ACCESS.activeLocality=0 and no requestUse pending. Locality may be acquired.

fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.name: Ready
fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.description: TPM_STS.commandReady=1; TPM accepts command-write octets via TPM_DATA_FIFO.

fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.name: Reception
fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.description: Host writing command body; TPM_STS.Expect=1 until last octet, then Expect=0.

fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.name: Execution
fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.description: Host wrote tpmGo=1; TPM executing; TPM_STS.dataAvail=0, stsValid valid.

fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.name: Completion
fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.description: TPM_STS.dataAvail=1; host reading response body from TPM_DATA_FIFO.

fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.name: Cancel
fsm_states_host_interface_per_locality.description: Host wrote TPM_STS.commandCancel=1; TPM aborts execution and returns TPM_RC_CANCELED.

fsm_hints.trigger: Host CPU drives every transaction; TPM never initiates. SERIRQ (or platform IRQ) only signals dataAvail / commandReady.
fsm_hints.rule: Locality must be claimed (TPM_ACCESS.requestUse) before any command is written; current locality is reported in TPM_ACCESS.activeLocality.
fsm_hints.abort: TPM2_Shutdown returns the TPM to a defined state; TPM_STS.commandCancel aborts a long-running command.

anti_deadlock_rule: When the host needs to defer to a higher-locality requester, it shall release the locality by writing TPM_ACCESS.activeLocality=1; the TPM then advances ownership to the highest-priority requester.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on the TPM runs its internal self-test (TPM2_SelfTest equivalent). Commands return TPM_RC_INITIALIZE until TPM2_Startup is executed. The first TPM2_Startup of a power cycle must be TPM_SU_CLEAR (cold start) or TPM_SU_STATE (resume after Shutdown(TPM_SU_STATE)). Failure mode is entered if a critical self-test fails.

default_ready_state_recommendation.TPM_STS.commandReady: 1 once self-test completed and TPM2_Startup accepted; 0 while executing.
default_ready_state_recommendation.TPM_ACCESS.activeLocality: 0 (no locality active) at startup; set by host via TPM_ACCESS.requestUse.

fsm_transitions_major.description: Fresh boot; PCRs reset; SPS/EPS preserved; PPS reseeded only if requested.
Orderly halt; PCRs and transient state will be lost.

configurations.name: Discrete TPM on LPC
configurations.description: LPC TIS interface; 33 MHz LCLK; locality windows at 4-KB offsets.

configurations.name: Discrete TPM on SPI
configurations.description: SPI TIS or CRB; up to 33 MHz SCLK; FIFO model identical.

configurations.name: Discrete TPM on I2C
configurations.description: I2C TIS; 400 kHz / 1 MHz SCL; FIFO model identical.

configurations.name: Firmware TPM (fTPM)
configurations.description: Same protocol over internal SoC IPC (ARM TrustZone or SGX).

timing_dependency_rule: All command/response octets are clocked by the host-supplied bus clock (LCLK / SCLK / SCL). Internal TPM execution time is bounded only by the per-command maximum execution time published in the platform spec; host shall poll TPM_STS.dataAvail rather than rely on a fixed wait.
